item.title: Overview of Zechariah - Hope Beyond the Ruins 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Imagine being part of a family that has spent years dreaming about returning home. As a child, you heard stories about the place from older relatives who remembered its former glory. They described a beautiful city filled with worship, security, and joy. They spoke of a magnificent temple where the presence of God dwelt among His people. They told stories about a great king from David’s line who would one day rule in righteousness and bring peace, not only to Israel but to the nations. These stories became part of your identity. They shaped your hopes and sustained your family through years of hardship.

item.title: Overview of Job - Trusting God When You Have No Answers
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story: When the Bottom Drops Out # Imagine a man named Daniel. He lives a steady, ordinary life in a small coastal town. He runs a family business, coaches his daughter’s netball team, and visits his parents every Sunday. Life isn’t perfect, but it’s stable, predictable, and safe.

item.title: Overview of 1 Samuel - Two Kings, Two Ways
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. A narrative of two kings, two ways of living, and one God who weighs the heart._ Opening Story # Aaron lived most of his life by instinct. If something felt right, he did it. If something felt difficult, he avoided it. He believed in God, but only in the background, like an emergency number he might call if life collapsed.

item.title: Overview of Genesis - The Book of Beginnings
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections_ A Story to Begin # Imagine standing beneath a sky untouched by city lights, the stars stretching endlessly above you. In that quiet moment, the biggest questions rise to the surface: Where did everything come from? Why am I here? What is the meaning of all this?
